origins.section: 17.2. The Identifier's Range Says How to Read a Dataset, and Only the Field's Definition Says What It Holds
17.3. DE 55 Is Composite but Has No Envelope
17.4. A Reader Walks the Envelopes, Steps Over What It Doesn't Know and Refuses What Overruns
17.7. The Same Field Number Means Different Things on a 1987 Link and a 2023 Link

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-unknown-dataset: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unknown-dataset: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unknown-dataset: 17.1 says each dataset announces its length so a reader can step over one it doesn't know, and 17.4 says to step over a valid but unknown identifier, which gives key c.
recorded.prompt:q-chip-at-dataset-level: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chip-at-dataset-level: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chip-at-dataset-level: 17.3 shows DE 55 read as datasets taking 9F as an identifier and the next two bytes as a length, refused only because the length overran and garbage otherwise, which matches key a.
recorded.prompt:q-reader-fix: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reader-fix: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reader-fix: 17.4 says the only way to know where an envelope starts is to start at the first one and skip each by its length, which is key a.
recorded.prompt:q-edition-mapping: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-edition-mapping: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-edition-mapping: 17.7 says the currency travels as tag 5F2A in dataset 01 of DE 49 in the CMF v3 draft and the switch maps through its internal format, which is key c.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-unknown-dataset:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unknown-dataset:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unknown-dataset:a: 17.2 says the bitmap doesn't say where one element ends and the next starts, so without the definition a reader can only separate a bitmap dataset by its length and do nothing more.
recorded.prompt:q-unknown-dataset:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unknown-dataset:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unknown-dataset:b: The 17.2 table puts 0x71 to 0xFE in the bitmap range, so 0x9A is not BER-TLV.
recorded.prompt:q-unknown-dataset:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unknown-dataset:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unknown-dataset:d: 17.1 says every dataset carries its own length, and 17.4 says to step over unknown datasets because refusing them breaks the reader when the network adds one.
recorded.prompt:q-chip-at-dataset-level:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chip-at-dataset-level:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chip-at-dataset-level:b: The 17.1 envelope diagram gives the length as 2 bytes after the identifier, so the length is 10 07, not 07.
recorded.prompt:q-chip-at-dataset-level:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chip-at-dataset-level:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chip-at-dataset-level:c: 17.4 says the envelope walk uses a fixed one-byte tag and two-byte length, which turns off the BER rules, so the routine does not decode 9F10 as a BER tag.
recorded.prompt:q-chip-at-dataset-level:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chip-at-dataset-level:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chip-at-dataset-level:d: 17.6 says 2.1.7 cmf.xml carries DE 34, 55, 71 and 104 alike as IFB_LLLLBINARY, and 17.3 says the application must keep the list of enveloped fields in configuration.
recorded.prompt:q-reader-fix:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reader-fix:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reader-fix:b: 17.4 says to step over a valid but unknown dataset, because a reader that refuses unknown datasets breaks the day the network adds one.
recorded.prompt:q-reader-fix:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reader-fix:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reader-fix:c: 17.4 says only an envelope's first byte is an identifier and the only way to find one is to walk from the first envelope, so any scan, including one from the end, can match a content byte.
recorded.prompt:q-reader-fix:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reader-fix:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reader-fix:d: In the 17.4 opening case the stray 01 was followed by 00 02, a length that fitted, and the gateway still returned 0531, so a length check does not reject a stray match.
recorded.prompt:q-edition-mapping:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-edition-mapping:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-edition-mapping:a: 17.7 says a switch never copies a field because the numbers match and shows a 1987 DE 49 of 840 read as identifier 38 with length 13360.
recorded.prompt:q-edition-mapping:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-edition-mapping:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-edition-mapping:b: 17.2 makes 0x71 a bitmap dataset whose meaning comes from the field's definition, and 17.7 places the currency in tag 5F2A of dataset 01.
recorded.prompt:q-edition-mapping:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-edition-mapping:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-edition-mapping:d: 17.7 says the currency travels where the 2023 specification puts it, tag 5F2A in dataset 01 of DE 49, so leaving it out is wrong.
